class.name: VECSComponentType
class.brief_description: Immutable metadata for a registered component type.
class.description: [b]VECSComponentType[/b] describes a component type registered either from C++ or from a script via [method VECSWorld.register_component]. It exposes the type's name, id, memory size and per-field metadata (sync priority, networked flag). Obtain it with [method VECSWorld.get_component_type].

method.name: get_field_is_networked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the field [param field] participates in network replication.

method.name: get_field_names
method.description: Returns the names of every field on this component type, in declaration order.

method.name: get_field_sync_priority
method.description: Returns the network sync priority of the field [param field]: [code]0[/code] realtime, [code]1[/code] high, [code]2[/code] medium, [code]3[/code] low, [code]4[/code] spawn-only, [code]5[/code] local (never networked).

method.name: get_id
method.description: Returns the internal numeric type id.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Returns the registered name of this component type.

method.name: get_size
method.description: Returns the byte size of one instance of this component.
